entities.name: Otto Winkelmann
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Otto Winkelmann was a German police official, SS-Obergruppenführer and General of the Waffen-SS who served as the Higher SS and Police Leader (HSSPF) in Hungary during the deportation and extermination of Hungarian Jews.
